## evolving sociality data
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(progress)
dataset_name <- "cons_env_data"

analysis_root <- "figure/cons_env_plot"
data_root     <- "data"

base_data_folders <- file.path(data_root, dataset_name)
r_data_folder    <- file.path("figure", "r_data", dataset_name)
additional_data_folder <- file.path(data_root, "cons_env_data_second_batch")

dir.create(r_data_folder, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# ---- Helper: choose the generation key column name ----
.gen_key <- function(d) {
  if ("tick" %in% names(d)) return("tick")
  if ("generation" %in% names(d)) return("generation")
  names(d)[1]
}

# ---- Helper: extract metadata from filename ----
extract_metadata <- function(path) {
  rx <- "n_(\\d+)_psi_(-?[0-9.]+)_sz_(-?\\d+)_reg_(fit|ext|ave)_(\\d+)_(\\d+)\\.tsv$"
  p  <- regmatches(basename(path), regexec(rx, basename(path)))[[1]]

  if (length(p) != 7) {
    stop("Could not extract metadata from file: ", basename(path))
  }

  data.frame(
    n          = as.integer(p[2]),
    psi        = as.numeric(p[3]),
    shift_size = as.integer(p[4]),
    reg        = p[5],
    rep        = as.integer(p[6]),
    ID        = as.integer(p[7]),
    file_id    = basename(path),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# ---- Helper: read one data file and attach metadata ----
read_one_data_file <- function(file) {
  df <- tryCatch(
    read.table(file, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", check.names = FALSE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(df)) {
    warning("Failed to read: ", file)
    return(NULL)
  }

  meta <- extract_metadata(file)

  df$n          <- meta$n
  df$psi        <- meta$psi
  df$shift_size <- meta$shift_size
  df$reg        <- meta$reg
  df$rep        <- meta$rep
  df$file_id    <- meta$file_id
  df$ID         <- meta$ID

  df
}

# ---- Helper: filter files by metadata ----
file_matches_filters <- function(file, psi_values, regimes, reps, group_sizes, shift_sizes) {
  meta <- tryCatch(extract_metadata(file), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(meta)) return(FALSE)

  (length(psi_values) == 0 || meta$psi %in% psi_values) &&
    (length(regimes) == 0 || meta$reg %in% regimes) &&
    (length(reps) == 0 || meta$rep %in% reps) &&
    (length(group_sizes) == 0 || meta$n %in% group_sizes) &&
    (length(shift_sizes) == 0 || meta$shift_size %in% shift_sizes)
}

# ---- Helper: load one data type folder ----
load_data_type <- function(data_type,
                           base_data_folder,
                           psi_values = c(),
                           regimes = c(),
                           reps = c(),
                           group_sizes = c(),
                           shift_size = c()) {
  
  folder <- file.path(base_data_folder, data_type)

  if (!dir.exists(folder)) {
    warning("Folder does not exist: ", folder)
    return(NULL)
  }

  file_list <- list.files(
    path = folder,
    pattern = "\\.tsv$",
    full.names = TRUE,
    recursive = TRUE
  )

  file_list <- Filter(
    function(file) file_matches_filters(file, psi_values, regimes, reps, group_sizes, shift_size),
    file_list
  )

  if (length(file_list) == 0) {
    warning("No matching files found in: ", folder)
    return(NULL)
  }

  pb <- progress_bar$new(
    format = "[:bar] :current/:total | :percent | ETA: :eta",
    total = length(file_list),
    clear = FALSE
  )

  checkpoint_length <- length(file_list) / 5
  if (checkpoint_length == 0) checkpoint_length <- length(file_list)
  
  df_list <- c()
  for (i in seq_along(file_list)){
    df_list[[i]] <- read_one_data_file(file_list[i])
    pb$tick()
    if ( i %% checkpoint_length == 0) {
      cat("Processed", i, "files out of", length(file_list), "\n")
      checkpoint <- do.call(rbind, df_list)

      # if(i != length(file_list)) {
      #   cat("Checkpointing at file #", i, "\n")
      #   saveRDS(checkpoint, file = file.path(r_data_folder, paste0(data_type, "_checkpoint_", i, ".rds")))
      # }
    }
  } 
 
  if (length(df_list) == 0) {
    warning("No readable files found in: ", folder)
    return(NULL)
  }
  df <- do.call(rbind, df_list)

  df
}

# ---- Helper: append only source files not already represented by file_id ----
append_new_files_by_file_id <- function(rds_file, data_folder) {
  if (!file.exists(rds_file)) {
    stop("RDS file does not exist: ", rds_file)
  }
  if (!dir.exists(data_folder)) {
    stop("Data folder does not exist: ", data_folder)
  }

  existing_data <- readRDS(rds_file)
  if (!is.data.frame(existing_data) || !"file_id" %in% names(existing_data)) {
    stop("RDS file must contain a data frame with a 'file_id' column: ", rds_file)
  }

  candidate_files <- list.files(
    data_folder, pattern = "\\.tsv$", full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE
  )
  valid_file <- vapply(candidate_files, function(file) {
    !is.null(tryCatch(extract_metadata(file), error = function(e) NULL))
  }, logical(1))
  if (any(!valid_file)) {
    warning("Ignoring files whose names do not match the expected metadata pattern.")
    candidate_files <- candidate_files[valid_file]
  }

  candidate_file_ids <- basename(candidate_files)
  duplicate_ids <- unique(candidate_file_ids[duplicated(candidate_file_ids)])
  if (length(duplicate_ids)) {
    stop(
      "Each file_id must identify exactly one source file. Duplicate file_id(s): ",
      paste(duplicate_ids, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  recorded_file_ids <- unique(as.character(existing_data$file_id))
  new_files <- candidate_files[!(candidate_file_ids %in% recorded_file_ids)]
  if (!length(new_files)) {
    message("No new files to append to: ", rds_file)
    return(invisible(existing_data))
  }

  progress <- progress::progress_bar$new(
    format = "[:bar] :current/:total | :percent | ETA: :eta",
    total = length(new_files),
    clear = FALSE
  )
  checkpoint_interval <- max(1, floor(length(new_files) / 3))
  new_data <- vector("list", length(new_files))

  for (i in seq_along(new_files)) {
    new_data[[i]] <- read_one_data_file(new_files[[i]])
    progress$tick()

    # Checkpoints contain only rows read during this append operation.
    # The final append to `rds_file` below is the complete updated dataset.
    if (i %% checkpoint_interval == 0 && i < length(new_files)) {
      checkpoint_data <- Filter(Negate(is.null), new_data[seq_len(i)])
      if (length(checkpoint_data)) {
        checkpoint_file <- file.path(
          dirname(rds_file),
          paste0(
            tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(rds_file)),
            "_new_data_checkpoint_", i, ".rds"
          )
        )
        saveRDS(do.call(rbind, checkpoint_data), checkpoint_file)
        message("Saved new-data checkpoint: ", checkpoint_file)
      }
    }
  }

  new_data <- Filter(Negate(is.null), new_data)
  if (!length(new_data)) {
    warning("No new files could be read; RDS file was not changed.")
    return(invisible(existing_data))
  }

  message("Appending ", length(new_data), " new file(s) to: ", rds_file)
  updated_data <- rbind(existing_data, do.call(rbind, new_data))
  message("saving updated data to: ", rds_file)
  saveRDS(updated_data, rds_file)
  message("Appended ", length(new_data), " file(s) to: ", rds_file)

  invisible(updated_data)
}
```

# load all data
```{r}
data_type_to_load <- c("genotype", "phenotype")
psi_values <- c()
regimes <- c()
reps <- 1:20
group_sizes <- c()
shift_size <- c()

for (data_type in data_type_to_load) {
  cat("Loading data type:", data_type, "\n")

  df <- load_data_type(
    data_type = data_type,
    base_data_folder = base_data_folders,
    psi_values = psi_values,
    regimes = regimes,
    reps = reps,
    group_sizes = group_sizes,
    shift_size = shift_size
  )

  if (is.null(df)) {
    cat("Skipping data type:", data_type, "\n")
    next
  }

  out_file <- switch(
    data_type,
    # "data"       = file.path(r_data_folder, "data_summary_fit.rds"),
    "data"       = file.path(r_data_folder, "data_summary.rds"),
    "genotype"   = file.path(r_data_folder, "genotype.rds"),
    "phenotype"  = file.path(r_data_folder, "phenotype.rds"),
    "fitness"    = file.path(r_data_folder, "fitness.rds"),
    "allele"     = file.path(r_data_folder, "allele.rds"),
    "copied_val" = file.path(r_data_folder, "copied_val.rds"),
    "group_tag" = file.path(r_data_folder, "group_tag.rds"),
    file.path(r_data_folder, paste0(data_type, ".rds"))
  )

  saveRDS(df, file = out_file)

  cat("Saved to:", out_file, "\n")
  cat("Done loading data type:", data_type, "\n")
}
```

# append files to one existing RDS data file
```{r append-new-files, eval=FALSE}
# Set these two paths, then run this chunk when the existing RDS should receive
# every new TSV file found in `data_folder`.
rds_file <- file.path(r_data_folder, "data_summary.rds")
data_folder <- file.path(additional_data_folder, "data")

append_new_files_by_file_id(
  rds_file = rds_file,
  data_folder = data_folder
)
```
